summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 based on extra-judicial confession; challenge to reliability of confessions before multiple witnesses; prosecution reliance on circumstantial evidence; appellate challenge to sufficiency of evidence; concurrent findings of guilt; admissibility and weight of extra-judicial confession; timing and circumstances of disclosure; credibility assessment of witnesses; no material corroboration beyond confession questioned; standard of proof in circumstantial cases; consideration of benefit of doubt.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence under Section 302 IPC upheld.
